Article 10 — Dividends

2. If the beneficial owner of the dividends is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax charged in the State of the company paying the dividends shall not exceed: (a) 10 per cent of the gross amount if the beneficial owner is a company which holds directly at least 10 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends; (b) 15 per cent of the gross amount in all other cases.

Article 11 — Interest

2. If the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, source-State tax shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest. 3. Interest is exempt from tax in the State in which it arises if it is derived and beneficially owned by the Government of the other Contracting State, including qualifying public bodies, or by a resident in connection with a loan or credit guaranteed by that Government.

Article 12 — Royalties

2. Source-State tax shall not exceed: (a) 10 per cent of the gross amount of royalties from literary, artistic or scientific copyright other than cinematograph, television or radio works, patents, trade marks, designs or models, plans, secret formulae or processes, industrial, commercial or scientific equipment, or industrial, commercial or scientific experience; (b) 15 per cent of the gross amount of royalties from cinematograph films and films or tapes for television or radio broadcasting.
